analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (201,500 KRW) below SMA5 (218,600 KRW), SMA20 (224,350 KRW), SMA50 (245,938 KRW): diagnosing short-to-mid term trend weakness.
· Below SMA100 (261,503 KRW), SMA200 (235,100 KRW): indicating weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (38.2%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.3 → 35.9): entering oversold territory, downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (837.7646 → -513.1014): worsening, bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 196,078 KRW): approaching lower band, band width at 25.20% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (189,200 KRW): based on Pivot S1 (177,533 KRW) and 20-day low (199,800 KRW).
· Swing resistance (209,000 KRW): below 5-day high (232,000 KRW) and Pivot PP (223,767 KRW).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low not formed, Lower High not formed): sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.35x): momentum in movement, increased reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): consider buying upon RSI oversold exit and confirmation of 5-day low support.
